news.title: July Edition: Newly Issued Patents
news.summary_en: Congratulations to Purdue Engineers who recently received patents on their intellectual property from the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office.

news.title: ME's Choi builds synthetic DNA structure that demonstrates a jitterbug transformation
news.summary_en: Purdue University researchers have successfully built a 3D DNA origami structure that performs a “jitterbug transformation,” mimicking the same behavior that enables viruses to deploy their payloads in nature.
